title: 1.1 Feedback FB-001 (behaviour): Refuse the IPv6 forms that carry an IPv4 address (F-479e3869; C-0ed78ab3)

message: no python test gate: diff coverage does not apply

reason: serena was not found on the agent PATH

notes: Gate run (`CI=true GITHUB_ACTIONS=true sh .l4/gates/test.sh`) shows exactly one failure: the new test_C_0ed78ab3_ipv4_embedding_ipv6_ranges_are_refused (AssertionError: 64:ff9b::a00:1 is currently public). All other pytest suites and all Go/TS suites report zero failures. The test asserts the allowed TargetNotAllowed reasons only (non_public_address); the outward mintkey:target_not_allowed mapping lives in the later agent-service-routes change and is not present in this unit.
The red test test_C_0ed78ab3_ipv4_embedding_ipv6_ranges_are_refused passes; full gate sh .l4/gates/test.sh exits 0. ruff and mypy --strict pass for mintkey_models.

title: 1.2 Feedback FB-002 (behaviour): A malformed agent-supplied URL is refused, never an error (F-a34b91c1; C-879687b1)

notes: The tests assert the module-level refusal (TargetNotAllowed with a non-empty reason) because the outward mintkey:target_not_allowed mapping lives in the later agent-service-routes change and is not present in this unit, matching the prior task 1.1 tests. No production code or existing tests were changed; the new file is the only source addition.

Change is confined to packages/python/mintkey-models/mintkey_models/egress.py. ruff check and mypy --strict pass for mintkey_models; sh .l4/gates/test.sh produced no JUnit failures/errors across all suites (mintkey-models: 102 tests, including the four test_C_879687b1_* cases).

title: 1.3 Feedback FB-003 (behaviour): The deny list matches names however they are written (F-93283de1; C-41b9e69f)

notes: New file: packages/python/mintkey-models/tests/test_egress_deny_names.py. The gate run shows the 7 new tests fail as expected; every other mintkey-models test passes. The log assertion accepts any log level and matches the word stem "ignor" in the record message, since the spec only requires that the unusable entry is reported once in the log as ignored.

Changed only packages/python/mintkey-models/mintkey_models/egress.py. egress_deny_names() now strips trailing dots from entries, drops useless entries (*, *., leading dot, *name) and logs one warning containing 'ignoring' per such entry per read; check_agent_target_url strips all trailing host dots and denies .localhost suffixes. Gate run with CI not forced but `sh .l4/gates/test.sh` exited 0 (all suites green); ruff and mypy --strict pass for mintkey-models.
